report.clinical_summary: The patient has been living with HIV for 4 weeks, taking Biktarvy as prescribed. They report persistent daily symptoms including fatigue, nausea (worse in mornings after medication), anxiety, and difficulty sleeping. They feel overwhelmed and have increased anxiety since starting treatment. They have not yet tried specific coping strategies but expressed openness to mindfulness/meditation. They understand their condition is chronic and that viral suppression typically takes a few months. They are engaged in their care and following the treatment plan.
